name: Shringara
description: The erotic or romantic sentiment. The eyelids flutter softly, cheeks rise in a gentle warmth, and the gaze glances coyly with divine longing.

name: Hasya
description: Comic sentiment or mirth. Eyes widen with dancing sparks, eyebrows curve quizzically, and the lips part in mocking or cheerful humor.

name: Karuna
description: Pathos and deep grief. Eyebrows droop inward, lower eyelids quiver with heavy stillness, evoking heartbreak, empathy, or loss.

name: Raudra
description: Furious wrath and indignation. The eyes blaze wide and red with intense focus, nostrils flare, and jaws clench in menacing fury.

name: Veera
description: Valor and righteous courage. The chest expands, brows lift with resolute nobility, and the gaze projects unwavering determination.

name: Bhayanaka
description: Dread and terror. The eyes dart restlessly from side to side, pupils dilate, and facial muscles tremble under imminent peril.

name: Bibhatsa
description: Loathing and aversion. The nose wrinkles, lips curl in sharp disdain, and the head turns away in total abhorrence.

name: Adbhuta
description: Awe and cosmic astonishment. Eyes open to their widest expanse, eyebrows arch skyward, and the performer takes in the miraculous.

name: Shanta
description: Supreme spiritual tranquility. The facial muscles soften into pure equilibrium, eyes gaze softly toward the horizon, undisturbed by worldly passions.
